events.event_name: ChillBar Protein Ice Cream Bar Free Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: ChillBar's first NYC pop-up, with a live DJ and samples of its protein ice cream bars as the brand launches in New York.
events.what_is_free: Free ChillBar protein ice cream bars are advertised in four flavors: Toasted Churro, Dark Cocoa, Midnight Mint, and Strawberries & Cream, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current NYC for FREE information says the bars are free, no RSVP is required, and distribution is while supplies last. Exact inventory by flavor is not guaranteed.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 10 from 5:30–8:30 PM at 11 Greene Street. Walk-in; no RSVP requirement is published.

events.address: Caffè Paradiso, 202 Elizabeth St, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A four-day café collaboration featuring a limited-edition Salted Mocha Butter & Oat Latte inspired by Summer Fridays' Holiday Collection Lip Butter Balms.
events.what_is_free: With purchase of the Summer Fridays latte, guests receive one full-size Lip Butter Balm plus a deluxe sample of Sunlit Vanilla Eau de Parfum while supplies last.
events.caveats: The beauty products are a purchase-with-purchase promotion, not a no-purchase giveaway. One balm per person, shade distributed at random, while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: September 10–13 from 8 AM–5:30 PM daily at Caffè Paradiso, 202 Elizabeth Street. The café is open to the public; no RSVP requirement is published.

events.event_name: Bvlgari Serpenti Infinito High Line Installation
events.address: The High Line at Little West 12th St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: Bvlgari's first U.S. Serpenti Infinito public-art installation, featuring a large-scale golden work by Plastique Fantastique on the High Line.
events.what_is_free: Viewing the outdoor public-art installation on the High Line is free.
events.caveats: Current sources agree that the installation runs September 10–20 on the High Line. It is a public outdoor installation; normal High Line access rules and operating conditions apply.
events.practical_notes: September 10–20, listed as 11 AM–7 PM daily. No RSVP or organizer approval is required to view the public installation.
